# Feature: V6 initiative rebuild keeps formula board

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-04 -->

## Intent
After MatchIntro initiative, `createGame` rebuild must keep V6 (`v6Formula`) so Formelgestell + Ausrüstung stay visible — not fall through to V3 Bound-4 / Live-3D.

## Preconditions
- Match started with pack choice `v6` / `V6_PACK_RULESET`
- `state.meta.v6FormulaEnabled === true` (and typically `v3CombatEnabled === true`)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Rebuild ruleset resolver prefers V6 over V3 when both meta flags are set
- [ ] After initiative rebuild, `meta.v6FormulaEnabled` stays true
- [ ] Playmat shows FormulaRig (not BoundCardRow 4 slots / BoardEngineLive empty)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Pure V3 match still resolves to `V3_RULESET`
- [ ] V5 match still resolves to `V5_PACK_RULESET`

## Assumptions
- Root cause: initiative rebuild checked `v3CombatEnabled` before `v6FormulaEnabled`

## Implementation Notes
- Helper: `rulesetForMatchRebuild`
- Wired in `PlayView` MatchIntro `onInitiativeResolved`
